description: Reproducible supporting computation for Uniform Lattice Bridges.

verification_conventions.exact_checks: Fraction arithmetic and independent dynamic enumeration.
verification_conventions.higher_order_errors: Observed residuals only; no finite universal constants asserted.
verification_conventions.explicit_bound_orientation: The theorem bounds exact/leading-1, not leading/exact-1.
verification_conventions.dense_rows: Computed from the parity saddle; exact counts are not evaluated.

nonlazy_upper_bound_counterexample.pi_bound_used: 333/106 < pi; this analytic bound is supplied in the article.
nonlazy_upper_bound_counterexample.scope: One exact counterexample. No minimality or first-violation claim.
